overview: An automated outbound lead generation system built with n8n, Apollo, Apify, Google Sheets, and Zoho CRM.
The system collects targeted leads, enriches their profiles, validates the data, creates personalized outreach sequences, and syncs qualified leads with the CRM.

blocks.p: The process starts with a simple form where the user enters the target job title and location.

list: Searches Apollo using the selected criteria
Extracts lead names, job titles, and LinkedIn profiles
Stores qualified leads in Google Sheets
Prevents duplicate records using the LinkedIn URL
Automatically starts the enrichment workflow when complete

blocks.p: The second workflow takes the collected LinkedIn profiles and enriches the lead data through Apify.

list: Retrieves additional contact and company information
Validates business email, name, company, size, and location
Stores qualified leads in Google Sheets
Creates a personalized five email outreach sequence
Structures the email content for CRM use
Pushes complete lead records into Zoho CRM
Clears temporary data after successful completion

blocks.p: Each qualified lead is added to Zoho CRM with:
User Input↓Apollo Search↓Lead Collection↓LinkedIn Validation↓Google Sheets↓Profile Enrichment↓Lead Validation↓Personalized Outreach↓Zoho CRM↓Data Cleanup

result: A complete outbound prospecting system that moves leads from Apollo search to enriched CRM records and ready to use outreach with minimal manual work.
